name: com.oreethehat.easy-ui
description: Window management, modal navigation and radial menus for Unity with Input System integration.

samples.description: HUD, inventory, nested settings, confirmation and radial menu. Requires EasyUI 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Independent building input gates for windows. Requires EasyBuilding 0.3.0+, EasyUI 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Event-driven resource balance labels. Requires EasyResources 0.3.0+, EasyUI 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Open a player window from an interaction action. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, EasyUI 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Localized window text using standard Unity Localization references. Requires EasyLocalization 0.2.0+, EasyUI 0.2.0+, Unity Localization 1.5.13+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Window feedback with an optional player context. Requires EasyFeedbacks 1.8.0+, EasyUI 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Player-owned UI contexts and a complete uGUI controls/rebinding window. Requires EasyInput 0.2.0+, EasyUI 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.

Reusable interaction/building list and radial windows, plus controls, language and audio settings. Requires EasyBuilding 0.3.0+, EasyFeedbacks 1.8.0+, EasyInput 0.2.0+, EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, EasyLocalization 0.2.0+, EasyResources 0.3.0+, EasyUI 0.2.0+. Import first: EasyBuilding / EasyResources; EasyUI / EasyBuilding; EasyUI / EasyFeedbacks; EasyUI / EasyInput; EasyUI / EasyInteraction; EasyUI / EasyResources.
